reasoning_trace.observation: JIP-26 requests 50,000 JitoSOL (~$12.5m) to fund the Cryptoeconomics subDAO for JTO buybacks and development of three mechanisms (Vault, TWAP, JTO Auction). CSD operates under existing JIP-17 4/6 multisig. Has executed $3.2m in buybacks to date.
reasoning_trace.inference: Treasury outflow of known amount to existing governance structure. Need to verify KPI specificity, milestone structure, and buyback supply impact.

reasoning_trace.observation: Author is drnick. Funds go to Cryptoeconomics subDAO (CSD) with existing 4/6 multisig. JTO token holders affected by buyback operations.
reasoning_trace.inference: Three stakeholder groups: proposer (drnick), beneficiary (CSD), affected group (JTO holders).

reasoning_trace.observation: Key Outcomes list deliverables but quarterly reports have no defined success thresholds. 'Strengthened data infrastructure' is undefined. No timeline bounds on contract delivery. No staged disbursement - single upfront transfer.
reasoning_trace.inference: Non-measurable outcomes and missing milestone-based disbursement structure. Emit vague_kpi and missing_milestone flags.

reasoning_trace.inference: Existing governance structure explicitly mentioned. Not a backdoor. Concentration of $12.5m in 6-person multisig qualifies as centralization (explicit, medium severity).
